details: testtestkjkldfnjdfn ships nebula.js, byte-identical to the nebulajs-api payload, and a preinstall.cjs that is a single opaque Function(...) call decoding XOR-encrypted code at install time. It is a new name for the nebulajs-api (MAL-2026-17220) campaign; the file hashes below match that record's evidence. The package presents itself as an ordinary utility, so the code runs on import or install without the user knowing.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
